title: Hawk Eye Drop
style: happy hardcore, uk hardcore, 174 bpm, gabber kick, supersaw lead, piano stab, euphoric breakdown, viral tiktok drop at 0:30, female topline chant, male hype rap verse, hoover synth, reverse cymbal builds
lyrics:
[Intro - reverse cymbal, supersaw rises, hoover synth swell]
(female chant, pitched up)
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop

[Build - 174 BPM, gabber kick rolls in]
(male hype rap, double-time)
three two one and the line goes red
hawk eye saw it before it was said
camera caught it, ball was in
system don't lie when the system kicks in

[Drop 1 - euphoric, piano stab, supersaw lead]
(female topline, big chant)
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop

[Verse - male hype rap]
the line judge blinked but the camera don't blink
the ball was in by half a millimeter, think
think about the work that built that lens
think about the math that found the friends

of every photon flying through the air
think about the engineers who didn't care
about the credit, just about the call
being right, being clean, being fair to all

[Build 2 - reverse cymbal, supersaw climbs higher]
three two one and the crowd goes up
hawk eye drop and the truth comes up
hawk eye drop and the call is clean
hawk eye drop and the line is seen

[Drop 2 - bigger, piano stab harder, gabber kick double]
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop

[Breakdown - euphoric, piano alone, female chant soft]
the truth was always there
we just built a way to see it
the truth was always there
we just built a way to see it

[Final Drop - everything stacked, biggest]
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop
hawk eye, hawk eye, hawk eye drop
hawk eye, hawk eye, never stop
hawk eye drop
hawk eye drop

[Outro - reverse cymbal tail, piano fades]
(female whisper)
the ball was in.
the call is clean.
hawk eye, never stop.
